simple.meaning: כְּהֻנָּה (kᵉhunnâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “priesthood.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 29:9. The surrounding context includes family, family line, altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כְּהֻנָּה (H3550) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: כְּהֻנָּה (kᵉhunnâh) / H3550 is traced through Exodus 29:9, Exodus 40:15, Numbers 3:10, Numbers 16:10 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”
You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’ ”

However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.” ’ ”
These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.
Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

definitions.full: H3550. kehunnah כְּהֻנָּה noun feminine priesthood ; — absolute ׳כ Exod 29:9 5 t.; construct כְּהֻנַּת Num 25:13 2 t.; suffix כְּהֻנַּתְכֶם 18:1 , 7 (twice in verse); כְּהֻנָּתָם 3:10 ; plural כְּהֻנּוֺת 1Sam 2:36 . — יהוה כהנת priesthood of ׳י , the portion of the Levites Josh 18:7 (D); plural priest's offices 1Sam 2:36 ; elsewhere Exod 29:9 ; 40:15 ; Num 3:10 ; 16:10 ; 18:1 , 7 (twice in verse); 25:13 (all P), Ezra 2:62 = Neh 7:64 ; 13:29 (twice in verse).
